claims.evidence: The witness sees used tires, but without sidewall information (DOT codes, brands, and origin markings), the 'Tokunbo' (imported used) status cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: Tires may be expired (over 6 years old).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the 4-digit DOT date code on the sidewall of each tire.

risks.risk: Structural failure due to sidewall bulges or cracks.
risks.proof: Photos of both the inner and outer sidewalls for every tire in the stack.
risks.if_unproven: as damaged and unsafe for use

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the tread with a depth gauge or a coin inserted into the grooves.

risks.risk: Internal damage or previous major repairs (patches/plugs).
risks.proof: Photos of the interior carcass of each tire.
Photos showing the size markings (e.g., 195/65R15) for all tires to confirm they are a set.
risks.if_unproven: as miscellaneous individual tires of the smallest common size

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the sidewalls showing size, brand, and DOT codes for all tires.
Photos of the inside of the tires to check for patches or plugs.
Tread depth measurements for each tire.
response.reason: The size, brand, and age of the tires are completely unknown because the sidewalls are not visible. These specifications are required to establish even a worst-case value.
